submitted.rationale: Index 10 (Sb 0.653, close to CuSb2O6 stoichiometry at 0.667) gave the highest measured EQE (0.00292%). The nearby compositions were much lower: 0.58 gave 0.001%, 0.689 gave 0.00029%, 0.43 gave 0.00071% and 0.80 gave 0.00008%. The response peaks sharply around the CuSb2O6 phase.
